review.images: Visually checked the developer’s own wide hero and seven gallery assets. Six gallery assets also appear under Pier Point. Selected the distinct Porto View exterior for the card and identified the shared interiors in captions.
review.location: Matched the named Emaar Porto View point and visually verified the four regional travel estimates on physical page 4 of its own brochure.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all 24 physical pages. Retained 23 residence sheets and all 30 imperial totals or range endpoints. Single totals reconcile within 0.01 sq ft. Preserved the printed component ranges without inferring unit pairings.

unavailable: Unit-specific signed areas and exact building entrances were not verified.
